name: Malachi
title: The Last Prophet
summary: Malachi is the last prophet in the Old Testament. His name means "my messenger." He prophesied after the temple was rebuilt, but criticized the people's lukewarmness and the priests' negligence. He concluded with the promise that Elijah would come before the Lord's day—fulfilled in John the Baptist.

keyEvents.title: God's Love for Israel
keyEvents.description: Malachi began by affirming God's love for Jacob over Esau.

keyEvents.title: Criticism of the Priests
keyEvents.description: Malachi rebuked the priests for offering sick and blind animals to God.

keyEvents.title: Tithes and Blessings
keyEvents.description: Malachi challenged the people to give full tithes and see God's blessing.

keyEvents.title: The Promise of Elijah
keyEvents.description: Malachi prophesied that God would send Elijah before the Lord's day - fulfilled in John the Baptist.
